standard_prerequisites.use: Reduces the final axioms (2) and (5) for the glued structure to generators, where they are inherited from gamma and delta.

core_obligations: Part (1): compute gamma_n(xy) = y^n gamma_n(x) = n! delta_n(y) gamma_n(x) = delta_n(y) x^n = delta_n(xy) on additive generators of IJ and extend by axiom (4).

Part (2): define epsilon_n(x + y) = sum gamma_i(x) delta_{n-i}(y); prove well-definedness by the displayed five-line chain using agreement on I cap J; check axioms (1) and (3) directly, (4) by regrouping the double sum, and (2), (5) via the generator criterion.
Conclude uniqueness of the glued structure.
proof_roadmap: Compute the agreement on IJ explicitly, define the glued maps by the convolution formula, verify well-definedness through the IcapJ agreement, and close the axioms via the generator criterion.
difficulty_reason: The well-definedness chain and the axiom-(4) regrouping are the substance; both are displayed in full but must be reproduced exactly.
